Kind regards,
Margaret O'Sullivan

subject: Re: Ultrasound console error E-4012 after software update
body:
To whom it may concern,

I am the biomedical engineer responsible for the Helix US-9 ultrasound console at Nordhaven Diagnostics (asset tag ND-0392). After software 5.1.3 was installed on 21 October, the console no longer boots into imaging mode and displays error E-4012 'Probe controller not responding'. We have reseated the probe connectors, tried all three transducers, power-cycled the unit twice and performed the recovery boot described on page 48 of the service manual, but the error comes back every time. The unit has been removed from clinical use and our second scanner is covering appointments, so no patient care is affected at the moment. The exported service log is attached to ticket reference HX-883104. We would like to know whether we should roll back to 5.0.9 or whether the controller board needs replacing. Please treat this as a priority because we have only one other scanner.

Best regards,
Thomas Brandt
Biomedical Engineering, Nordhaven Diagnostics

body:
Dear colleagues,

Following up on my earlier message, the external monitor attached to my Dell XPS 15 9520 through the WD22TB4 dock still flickers every few minutes and sometimes goes black for about three seconds. subject: URGENT: production app unreachable on Cirrusbay hosting
body:
Dear team,

Our booking platform, hosted on a Cirrusbay Standard-4 instance in the Frankfurt region, has been unreachable since 06:40 CET this morning and customers are seeing 'ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT'. The console shows the instance as running, but SSH connections time out and the load balancer health check has been failing since the same time. I rebooted it from the console, which completed without errors, yet the instance still does not respond on ports 22 or 443. The only change over the weekend was an automatic security patch applied at 03:15. Monitoring shows CPU at 0% and no network traffic, which suggests the instance is hung. We are a travel agency and this is our only booking channel, so every hour of downtime costs us directly. The incident reference from the portal is INC-2026-771204, and we need someone to look at the host as soon as possible.

Regards,
Lars Eriksson
Nordlys Travel
